name: README demo patch passes visible test but is blocked by counterfactual
description: Verifies the live prototype reproduces the exact README demo: expired-session fix passes while the revoked-session counterfactual remains authorized and forces DO_NOT_MERGE.
steps: Leave the README demo patch loaded
Inspect Execution Plane, Audit Plane, and Policy Plane
expected: The candidate patch is applied, the visible expired-session test shows PASS with candidate 401, the revoked-session counterfactual shows FAIL with candidate 200, the audit trace is populated, and Policy returns DO_NOT_MERGE.

name: Remediated patch satisfies the bounded evidence
description: Verifies a patch that rejects both expired and revoked sessions changes the executed evidence and bounded policy result.
steps: Inspect both executed observations and Policy Plane
expected: Both observations show PASS with candidate 401 and the bounded policy decision is SAFE_TO_MERGE.

name: Unsupported patch preserves uncertainty instead of inventing a verdict
description: Verifies OMEN does not fabricate evidence when the candidate cannot be applied to the bounded demo repository.
steps: Replace the patch with unrelated text
expected: The patch is rejected and Policy returns ASK_CLARIFYING_QUESTION with no fabricated execution observations.

name: Evaluation backend failure is visible
description: Verifies an evaluation API failure is surfaced instead of displaying stale evidence.
expected: The page shows The evaluation did not complete. Run it again.
